title: Timestamp Converter
description: Convert a Unix timestamp to a human-readable date/time, or a date/time back into a Unix timestamp.

input.title: Input
input.clearConfirmDescription: This will remove the current input and result. This can't be undone.

output.title: Result
output.emptyTimestampToDate: Enter a Unix timestamp to convert.
output.invalidTimestampDescription: This isn't a valid timestamp. Enter a whole or decimal number of seconds or milliseconds.
output.invalidDateDescription: This isn't a recognized date/time. Use YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, or an ISO 8601 string with an offset.
